fields.office: NWS Storm Prediction Center Norman OK
fields.riskHeadline: ...THERE IS AN ENHANCED RISK OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING ACROSS THE MIDDLE OHIO VALLEY...
fields.summary: Severe thunderstorms capable of damaging winds, large hail and a few tornadoes are expected from the Ohio Valley into the central Appalachians this afternoon and evening.

areaDiscussions.heading: Middle Ohio Valley
areaDiscussions.text: A cold front will move east into a warm, moist airmass. Surface dewpoints in the mid 60s and steep midlevel lapse rates will support MLCAPE near 2000 J/kg. Strong deep-layer shear favors supercells capable of tornadoes, large hail and damaging gusts through the evening.

areaDiscussions.heading: Central Appalachians
areaDiscussions.text: Storms will weaken after sunset as instability decreases, but a linear segment may continue to produce isolated damaging gusts.
